capture.transport: Website client -> real my-servers Edge handler -> loopback CP owner HTTP -> IPC -> runtime -> migrated ephemeral PGlite
capture.sanitization: All accounts, servers, jobs, tokens, releases and state are synthetic. Authorization headers are redacted. v1.json replaces generated server/job IDs with fixed synthetic UUIDs; the capture retains generated synthetic IDs.
capture.additionalCases: Other states/errors in v1.json are declared protocol boundary cases, not claims of captured production responses.
capture.finalHeads: Capture pins implementation commits and their source digests. Both final tested PR heads and a fresh cross-repo run with exact commands are recorded in paired PR evidence after fixture/test/documentation commits.
capture.sourceDigestEncoding: sha256 of UTF-8 source with CRLF normalized to LF
capture.limits: Real Website client and Edge handler, CP owner HTTP/IPC/runtime and migrated PGlite. Synthetic auth/release/runner/storage; loopback HTTP via injected transport. Not proven: deployed Edge/JWT verification/TLS, browser, installed runner/CRIU/Podman, public UDP, gameplay or production.
